name: Cold Chain Status Unknown
anti_triggers: dry-only or refrigerated status already bounded with evidence
physical_basis: Cold-chain duty changes refrigeration load, infiltration sensitivity, peak profile and operating economics.
operational_basis: Dry warehouse, cold-chain, fulfillment and cross-dock nodes differ materially in service design and energy drivers.
financial_mechanism: Misclassifying the asset family can corrupt comparison, underwriting and dominant-variable selection.
typical_false_assumption: All warehouse-family assets are comparable enough for one benchmark logic.
hypothesis: Cold-chain status is not a detail; it may change the asset family and the valid comparison basis.
rival_hypotheses: asset family classification is already adequate
falsification_conditions: no refrigerated or temperature-controlled duty evidenced
allowed_claim_language: Cold-chain status remains a structurally important classification question and can change the valid asset family.
escalation_conditions: operator confirmation required if public evidence remains insufficient
example_outputs: Cold-chain status is not a detail. It changes the asset family.
tests: warehouse acceptance bundle should activate this when subtype and temperature-control status remain unresolved
